snippet.title: Cyber Farmer - Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cyber Famer Demo is now available on Steam.

Welcome to a futuristic farming simulator where old meets new! Take over your grandpa's farm in a post-apocalyptic world☢️, utilizing cyber technology 🤖, modified plants🌾, and even cyber pigs🐷.

 Demo Steam Card here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3739800/Cyber_Farmer_Demo

Wishlist full game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461890/Cyber_Farmer/

#CyberFarmer #farminggame #gaming
